detail: Remaining v2.1 items are design-blocked, not code-blocked. Recommendations to confirm or override: #32 — auto-touch/upsert the agent registry on every record/post/decide write (agent_id defaults to "main" when absent), keep TTL only for live-status display and never expunge historical participants; the W4 shared-registry daemon is a separate later bet. #33 — field evidence (zero handoff/acknowledge calls across 3 repos vs 40+ rich committed markdown handoff docs) favors retiring the structured handoff surface at v3 rather than redesigning it; if anything survives, it's a first-class pointer to a committed doc. #42 — server-side single-instance guard per project (second instance detects the dashboard port/lock and skips dashboard or exits cleanly) is the structural fix; the ${TWINING_MCP_CMD:-npx} env-expansion escape hatch (claude-code#9427) is a cheap additive once verified. Coding starts on whichever of these Dave green-lights.
summary: v2.1 design pass awaits Dave: #32 agent identity (rec: auto-upsert registry on writes), #33 handoffs (rec: retire at v3), #42 dual server (rec: single-instance guard). Details in entry.
